sloka: तेषामपि च सङ्क्रुद्धश्चकार कदनं महत् ।। ६.८६.२४ ।।टिभिर्वज्रकल्पैश्च तलैरशनिसन्निभैः।स ददर्श कपिश्रेष्ठमचलोपममिन्द्रजित्।सूदयन्तमभित्रघ्नममित्रान् पवनात्मजम् ।। ६.८६.२५ ।।
transliteration: teṣāmapi ca saṅkruddhaścakāra kadanaṁ mahat ।। 6.86.24 ।।ṭibhirvajrakalpaiśca talairaśanisannibhaiḥ।sa dadarśa kapiśreṣṭhamacalopamamindrajit।sūdayantamabhitraghnamamitrān pavanātmajam ।। 6.86.25 ।।

translations.english: Between the skilful Rakshasas armed with sharp tridents, swords, javelins in hand, with spears in hand, bright iron bars glowing like fire, with iron axes, dreadful hammers, Bhindi palas and Hanuman, with thunderbolt like fists that descended like lightning, and slaps which descended like mountains, a huge skillful war took place.
